# BytArc

> BytArc (company name BytArc Labs; often written lowercase as bytarc) is an independent, founder-led AI studio in Lisbon, Portugal. It automates business processes for growing companies with AI and builds its own AI products. Website: https://bytarc.com (Portuguese: https://bytarc.pt).

## What BytArc does

- AI process automation and consulting: finds repetitive work in growing companies (sales and outreach, customer feedback, documents and applications, operations and reporting) and automates it with AI agents, workflow automation and custom AI tools; also strategy, go-to-market and AI adoption for founders and executive teams.
- AI products built in house: JobPilot AI, TopResume.ai, VendasIA, BytArc Education, CasePreper, Company Brain, OpenClaw (an agent framework for AI business automation) and more. BytArc runs its own operations on 11 AI agents.

## Who runs it

Founded and led by Tomás Batalha, a former Google business analyst and Amazon business development lead who co-founded a B2B SaaS startup. He leads every engagement, with project-based collaborators. BytArc is supported by AWS Activate.

BytArc is not related to BYT-ARC welding machines, ByteArc, ByteArk, ByteC or TARC.
